title: Mystic Apothecary Corner
description: A richly detailed fantasy shop interior with purple cracked walls covered in framed paintings of snakes, keys, an hourglass and magical symbols. A wooden counter draped in green velvet holds scattered gold coins, scrolls, candles and potion bottles while a partially visible shopkeeper in purple robes stands behind it. Shelves display glowing blue lanterns, hanging herbs, and mystical curios under a starry ceiling.
prompt: Interior of a mystical purple apothecary shop with cracked walls covered in many framed paintings of red and green snakes, golden keys, hourglasses and arcane symbols. Wooden counter with green velvet cloth, scattered gold coins, rolled scrolls, red candles and potion vials. A shopkeeper in ornate purple robes stands at the counter. Shelves filled with glowing blue lanterns, hanging green and purple herbs, dried flowers, and glass display cases. Cinematic lighting with magical atmosphere.
